name: podman
description: Daemonless Docker-compatible container engine with rootless support and OCI compliance

podman.description: Daemonless container runtime with Docker-compatible CLI and advanced security features
podman.usage:
podman run -it --rm alpine:latest sh
podman build -t myapp .
podman images --format json | jq '.[]'
podman pod create --name webapp && podman run -d --pod webapp nginx
podman machine init && podman machine start

gvproxy.description: VPN proxy server for Podman machine networking and port forwarding

win-sshproxy.description: SSH proxy helper for Windows Podman machine communication and tunneling
